repos_data.description: MCP server for the Live Tennis API — give Claude, Cursor and other LLM agents real-time tennis scores, odds and model win-probability

Unified MCP server — 41 sports API providers, 396 tools in one process: scores, stats, odds, esports, F1/MotoGP/NASCAR, EuroLeague, chess, AFL, boxing & more across 70+ sports. 19 work with no API key.

Free, open-source sports-data MCP server — 801 tools across 63 providers: cross-book betting odds, official league stats, racing, fantasy, cricket, F1, chess and esports. 43 providers need no key at all. Claude Desktop / Cursor / any MCP client.
